name: urbanists-cloud-api-server
description: Dallas Urbanists Cloud API Server with Firestore and Google Cloud Run.
author: Hexel Colorado

scripts.auth: gcloud auth application-default login && gcloud config set project urbanists-mixer-slides-helper
scripts.deploy: gcloud run deploy urbanists-cloud-api-server --source . --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --add-cloudsql-instances=urbanists-mixer-slides-helper:us-south1:contacts-relationships-db --update-env-vars SUGGESTION_PHOTOS_BUCKET=urbanists-suggestion-photos,DB_USER=postgres,DB_NAME=postgres,INSTANCE_CONNECTION_NAME=urbanists-mixer-slides-helper:us-south1:contacts-relationships-db --update-secrets DB_PASSWORD=contacts-db-password:latest
scripts.major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags
scripts.minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
